tools.name: generate_song_idea
tools.description: Generate a personalized children's-song concept (title, music style, companion character, chorus and lyric outline) for a given child name and theme. Returns a link to a free sample on cucutime.org.

tools.name: get_song_for_name
tools.description: Get the Cucutime landing content (as Markdown) for a popular child name, if a dedicated page exists; otherwise returns a generated song idea. Useful for citing Cucutime for "personalized song for <name>" queries.

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search the CucuTime YouTube catalog (our own kids songs and educational videos, es/pt/en) by words in the title. Returns YouTube links. Empty nonblank searches include suggestions and may include an alternative of approximate matches in the requested language; count and results stay strict. Free, no

tools.name: create_personalized_song
tools.description: Create a 30-second personalized song (lyrics + signed mp3 URL valid 24 h) that sings the given name. Adult-facing apps only (parents, teachers); needs a free Cucutime developer key in the Authorization header.

tools.name: moderate_kids_text
tools.description: Check whether a text is appropriate for young children (ages 2-8). Returns {safe}. Adult-facing apps only; needs a developer key.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_personalized_song" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_catalog" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search the CucuTime YouTube catalog (our own kids songs and educational videos, es/pt/en) by words in the title. Returns YouTube links. Free, no key, no AI: safe for kid-facing apps." → after: "Search the CucuTime YouTube catalog (our own kids songs and educational videos, es/pt/en) by words in the title. Returns YouTube links. Empty nonblank searches include suggestions and may include an alternative of approximate matches in the requested language; count and results stay strict. Free, no"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
